cfg.delete_all_stored_card_clips_and_til: Delete all stored card clips and tile images? They are recreated automatically when needed.
cfg.desc_chkAllowInvalidCerts: For Radarr, Sonarr, Seerr and the download clients over https with their own certificate or by IP address. Only turn this on for your own network.
cfg.desc_chkPageBackdrops: The large photo behind the page, which changes along with the title you are on. Off gives a calm, plain background and saves loading work on a TV. Emby's own "Backdrops" setting still applies on top of this.
cfg.desc_chkPrecreateCards: Off (recommended): a confirmation card is only made when someone presses Play. On: every channel refresh makes a card and tile for every title in the background. That costs hours of ffmpeg work and tens of GB of disk space.
cfg.desc_chkUpdateBeta: Test versions are newer but less tested.
cfg.desc_chkUpdateRestart: If off, the new version is installed but only becomes active the next time Emby restarts.
cfg.desc_limit: Applies to requests through Discover to Radarr and Sonarr. Administrators have no limit. With Seerr, the limits you set per user in Seerr apply.
cfg.desc_nzbget: Username and password of NZBGet (Settings > Security, ControlUsername and ControlPassword).
cfg.desc_ombiAsUser: Through an API key Ombi cannot request on behalf of another user: every request comes in under the owner of the key, with the name of the requester added as a label. The per-user limit below therefore stays in effect, and approval in Ombi follows the permissions of that key.
cfg.desc_ombiKey: Found in Ombi under Settings > Configuration > General.
cfg.desc_qbit: Username and password of the qBittorrent web interface. If qBittorrent allows access without a password for this address, they can stay empty. From qBittorrent 5.2 you can use an API key instead (qBittorrent: Options → WebUI → API Key); it then takes precedence.
cfg.desc_requestService: With Seerr, requests go to Seerr, which passes them on to its own Radarr and Sonarr. You then do not need to set up Radarr and Sonarr here.
cfg.desc_sab: With a downloader (SABnzbd, NZBGet, qBittorrent, Transmission) the progress also shows the speed and the stages after 100% (verifying, repairing, unpacking, moving, script); with SABnzbd and NZBGet also whether it is paused or has a limit, with torrents also seeders and ratio. Only set up what you use; empty = only what Radarr/Sonarr report.
cfg.desc_sabKey: Found in SABnzbd under Config > General > Security (the normal API key, not the NZB key).
cfg.desc_seerrAsUser: Whoever is signed in to Emby and also exists in Seerr requests with their own Seerr account (with the permissions, limits and approval from Seerr). If someone is not in Seerr, the request is made as the owner of the API key.
cfg.desc_seerrKey: Found in Seerr under Settings > General.
cfg.desc_selAccent: Applies to everyone on this server: the Discover page, the popup and the rows on Emby's own pages.
cfg.desc_selPosterScore: The IMDb score comes from the free IMDb dataset (non-commercial use only), no API key needed; the server downloads it itself and refreshes it weekly. Without IMDb data the TMDB score is shown.
cfg.desc_storage: Cleanup runs 2 minutes after startup and then every 24 hours. If the folder is too large, the oldest files go first. Deleted files are recreated automatically when needed. Save the settings before you clean up.
cfg.desc_trakt: Create an app on trakt.tv under Settings > Your API Apps (redirect: urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob) and paste the Client ID here. Your watchlist must be public. Empty = no row.
cfg.desc_trans: Username and password of Transmission; leave empty if the web interface asks for none.
cfg.desc_txtFanartKey: Not needed normally: the title logo at the top of the popup comes from TMDB. Only when TMDB has no logo for a title and a key is set here, fanart.tv is asked. Free key: fanart.tv, account page, Personal API Key. The key stays on the server.
cfg.desc_txtMdblistKey: Free at mdblist.com (Preferences, API Access). Gives the popup the scores of IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes (critics and audience), Metacritic, Letterboxd and Trakt. With a key here MDBList comes before OMDb; OMDb stays the fallback.
cfg.desc_txtOmdbKey: Free from omdbapi.com (1000 requests per day). With it the popup also shows the IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores. Empty = TMDB score only.
cfg.desc_txtTmdbList: A public list on TMDB, for example your own watchlist list. Empty = no row.
cfg.desc_users: Tick who may make requests. A user without a tick can still browse and watch trailers, but a request is not sent to Radarr or Sonarr and the user gets a message. New users are allowed by default.
cfg.emby_is_restarting_refresh_the_page_: Emby is restarting. Refresh the page in a minute.

The Emby apps (TV, mobile) are not affected; there Discover works through the channel.
